notes: Reviewed against OrderMixin, PredicateHelper, SeriesEpochManager, BitInvalidatorLib, RemainingInvalidatorLib, MakerTraitsLib/TakerTraitsLib, OrderLib, SafeERC20 (1inch solidity-utils), Pausable/Ownable. The small functions were read line by line (and/or/not/eq/lt/gt predicates, arbitraryStaticCall, simulate with its SimulationResults revert, permitAndCall with the six permit encodings and the Permit2 address chosen by chainid, cancelOrder(s), bitsInvalidateForOrder, increaseEpoch/advanceEpoch, epoch views, remaining invalidators, hashOrder). fillContractOrder (547 lines), fillContractOrderArgs (963) and fillOrder (1,057) were read by structure (checks in source order: remaining invalidator, ERC-1271 or ECDSA signature, paused, extension validity, private order, expiration, epoch manager, amount computation with the threshold checks, invalidation, pre/post interactions, transfers with permit2 and WETH, OrderFilled event); fillOrderArgs (2,343 lines) by structure only. Loops: 3 source loops (and, or, cancelOrders) all shown as readable while loops; no implicit loop is printed as a while (via-IR copies are copy lines). The text is otherwise clean (via-IR build): calldata copies, named custom errors, resolved Permit2 calls. No execution run: no semantic suspicion remained.
summary: Readable and faithful on every path read, with its 3 loops present; the main defects are the fill functions' common tail duplicated per amount path, 22 calls whose resolved selector is printed as a memory expression in the function-name slot, and a few unfolded constant phis.
